representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with an empty public schema and auth.users present

preflight.expectedAffectedRows: New table created empty; no rows are touched in any existing table

execution.resumeStrategy: Rerun the idempotent create-table/create-index/create-trigger sequence; every object uses IF NOT EXISTS or OR REPLACE
execution.idempotency: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, CREATE TRIGGER after drop-if-exists

quarantine.strategy: No tenant keys or user data are inferred, backfilled, or quarantined; the table starts empty

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Constraints are declared inline on a brand-new table; the unique partial index is created with WHERE (is_default = true AND status = 'active') and has no pre-existing rows to validate

recovery.rollback: Drop the new table and its trigger function in a forward migration if the family is rolled back
recovery.forwardFix: Any further style-profile shape changes are additive migrations

queries: select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'post_style_profiles'
